passive.name: Jade Soul, Frozen Heart
passive.text: The equipper's DMG ignores **20/22/24/26/28%** of the target's **Physical RES**. When the equipper activates an **Ether Veil**, the equipper's DMG increases by **25/28.7/32.5/36.2/40%** and CRIT DMG increases by **25/28.7/32.5/36.2/40%** for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

passive.name: Scorching Breath
passive.text: Upon hitting an enemy with a **Basic Attack**, **Dash Attack**, or **Dodge Counter**, the equipper's ATK increases by **3.5/4.4/5.2/6/7%** for 8s, stacking up to 8 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Tranquil Blossom
passive.text: CRIT DMG is increased by **30/34.5/39/43.5/48%**. When the equipper lands a hit with a **Basic Attack**, **Special Attack**, or **Aftershock**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's CRIT DMG by an additional **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, stacking up to 3 times. The effect lasts for 30s, with each stack's duration calculated separately, and can only be triggered once per use of a skill. With all 3 stacks, the equipper's **Electric DMG** increases by **20/23/26/29/32%**.

passive.name: Scorching Breath
passive.text: Upon hitting an enemy with a **Basic Attack**, **Dash Attack**, or **Dodge Counter**, the equipper's ATK increases by **3.5/4.4/5.2/6/7%** for 8s, stacking up to 8 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Knight's Combo
passive.text: Launching a **Dodge Counter** or **Quick Assist** increases the equipper's ATK by **12/13.8/15.6/17.4/19.2%** for 12s.

skillPriority: Basic Attack > Chain Attack > Special Attack > Dodge > Assist

entries.name: Basic Attack: Swiftedge
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Can be chained into **Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash** after the 4th hit.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Cloudstream Sword Will
entries.text:
Hold Basic Attack to activate:
Launches a flurry of blade shockwaves, dealing **Physical DMG**. Hold to extend the attack.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during this skill.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents
entries.text:
While in the **Enlightened Mind** state and on the ground, press Basic Attack to activate:
Performs up to three forward slashes, dealing **Physical DMG**.
If struck by an enemy attack during the 3rd hit, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
If she possesses **Qingming Sword Force**, the 3rd hit is replaced with **Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent
entries.text:
While in the **Enlightened Mind** state and with **Qingming Sword Force**, after the 2nd hit of **Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Splitting Currents**, press Basic Attack to activate:
Launches a swift rising attack, dealing **Physical DMG** and entering an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum
entries.text:
After activating **Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation**, and with **Qingming Sword Force**, press Basic Attack to activate:
Launches a wide sweeping slash forward, dealing massive **Physical DMG**. On hit, 1 point of **Qingming Sword Force** is consumed.
If struck by an enemy during the skill, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG and increasing the skill's Interrupt Level.
After using this skill and with **Qingming Sword Force**, press EX Special Attack to consume 1 point of **Qingming Sword Force** and launch a hit of **EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light**. This skill is automatically followed up with **Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent**, and Ye Shunguang enters an airborne state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight
entries.text:
In the **Enlightened Mind** state, and while airborne, press Basic Attack to activate:
Launches up to two downward slashes in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the **Enlightened Mind** state during this skill.
Press EX Special Attack or Dodge to follow up with **Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Annihilation
entries.text:
After the 2nd hit of **Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight**, press Basic Attack to activate:
Performs a falling attack in front, entering a grounded state, and dealing **Physical DMG**.
When launching this skill with 2 or more points of **Qingming Sword Force**, Ye Shunguang will perform a downward falling strike across a large area in front instead, dealing massive **Physical DMG**. On hit, 2 points of **Qingming Sword Force** are consumed, granting the **Culmination** effect. After using this skill, if Ye Shunguang possesses **Qingming Sword Force**, press EX Special Attack to consume 1 point of **Qingming Sword Force** and launch a hit of **EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light**, which can be quickly followed up with **Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum**.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the **Enlightened Mind** state during this skill.
During this skill, if attacked by enemies, triggers a block, negating that instance of DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

Daze Multiplier With Qingming Sword Force
DMG Multiplier Without Qingming Sword Force
Daze Multiplier Without Qingming Sword Force

entries.name: Culmination
entries.text: During **EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light**, each time **Qingming Sword Force** is consumed while **Culmination** is active, the **Qingming Sword Force** cost is replaced by consuming **Culmination** instead. This effect does not stack, and lasts until the current **Enlightened Mind** ends.

entries.name: Dodge: Leave No Trace
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
During the **Enlightened Mind** state, and if a **Perfect Dodge** is triggered, press Basic Attack to activate **Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent**.

entries.name: Dodge: Wandering Cloud
entries.text:
While tilting the joystick, hold Dodge to activate:
Enters a high-speed movement state. Steer with the joystick, and release the joystick to stop.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Phantasm Dash
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Swallow Strike
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness
entries.text:
With 6 **Qingming Sword Force** and while not in the **Enlightened Mind** state, hold Basic Attack to activate, or press Switch while in combat and switch on-field from off-field to activate:
Enters the **Enlightened Mind** state and activates **Ether Veil: Verdict**.
Deals **Physical DMG** to enemies in a large area in front.
Activating this skill is considered as activating a **Quick Assist**.
Enters the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Support Guard
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Leaps into the air and thrusts forward, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Cease Hostility
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Deals massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: When I Return
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Enlightened Mind - Tactical Support
entries.text:
While in the **Enlightened Mind** state, when the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Launches a forward slash, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Enlightened Mind - Unification
entries.text:
While in the **Enlightened Mind** state and after a **Defensive Assist**, press Basic Attack to activate:
Deals massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Guiding Tides
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a **Dodge**.
If no dodge is available or a **Perfect Dodge** is not triggered, launches a quick sword energy attack that deals **Physical DMG**.
If a **Perfect Dodge** is triggered at this time, launches a flying sword attack, dealing **Physical DMG**, and immediately follow up with the 2nd hit of **Basic Attack: Swiftedge**.
Character is briefly invulnerable during the skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Gale Suppression
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Launches a rushing slash and a flying sword attack at the enemy, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Enemy attacks can be dodged during this skill.
After this skill is used, gain 1 point of **Qingming Sword Force**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Clean Exit
entries.text:
While in the **Enlightened Mind** state and grounded, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Performs a swift backstep slash, dealing **Physical DMG**.
If a dodge is available, 1 dodge chance is consumed, and the action is counted as activating a **Dodge**.
If a **Perfect Dodge** is triggered at this time, press Basic Attack to quickly activate **Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum** and enter **Vital View**.
After this **Enlightened Mind - Sunderlight Maximum** activates, it can be immediately followed up with **Basic Attack: Enlightened Mind - Skyward Ascent**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light
entries.text:
In the **Enlightened Mind** state and with **Qingming Sword Force**, hold EX Special Attack to activate:
Performs quick consecutive slashes, dealing massive **Physical DMG** while rapidly consuming **Qingming Sword Force** until none remains.
The skill ends early if **Qingming Sword Force** is insufficient or if EX Special Attack is released.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the **Enlightened Mind** state during this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

1 Qingming Sword Force Consumed Daze Multiplier

6 Qingming Sword Force Consumed Daze Multiplier

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust
entries.text:
In the **Enlightened Mind** state, press Ultimate or hold EX Special Attack when all **Qingming Sword Force** is expended to activate:
Deals massive **Physical DMG** to enemies in a large area.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the **Enlightened Mind** state during this skill.
After using this skill, **Ether Veil: Verdict** is removed and the **Enlightened Mind** state ends.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Smite the Wicked
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Chasing Storms
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Summons a sword formation and enter the **Enlightened Mind** state, activating an **Ether Veil: Verdict** while also gaining 6 **Qingming Sword Force**. This skill deals massive **Physical DMG**.
Upon activating this skill, if Decibels are consumed, press Ultimate while in this **Enlightened Mind** state to launch an **Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens** that doesn't consume Decibels.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Enlightened Mind - Lure Thunder
entries.text:
While in the **Enlightened Mind** state, and when a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful slash at enemies ahead in a large area, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the **Enlightened Mind** state during this skill.
Enter the airborne state after using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens
entries.text:
After consuming Decibels to launch **Ultimate: Chasing Storms** and while in the **Enlightened Mind** state, press Ultimate or hold EX Special Attack when all **Qingming Sword Force** is expended to activate:
Summons a massive blade, dealing massive **Physical DMG** to enemies.
Ye Shunguang will not exit the **Enlightened Mind** state during this skill.
After using this skill, the **Enlightened Mind** state ends, and **Ether Veil: Verdict** is removed.
This skill doesn't consume Decibels.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Burning Clarity
entries.text:
When not in the **Enlightened Mind** state and with fewer than 6 points of Qingming Sword Force, certain attacks slowly build **Qingming Sword Force**. Whenever **Qingming Sword Force** is gained by any means, each 1 point of **Qingming Sword Force** that exceeds the limit is converted into 1 stack of **Bearer**, stacking up to 3 times. Upon leaving the **Enlightened Mind** state, all **Bearer** stacks are consumed to grant the same number of **Qingming Sword Force** stacks.
Upon entering the battlefield, gain **Unity**, increasing CRIT Rate by **30%** and DMG by **25%**.
When **Ultimate: Chasing Storms** or **Entry Skill: Illuminating Darkness** is unleashed, Ye Shunguang enters the **Enlightened Mind** state and activates **Ether Veil: Verdict**. **Ether Veil: Verdict** has the same duration as **Enlightened Mind**. The duration lasts 16s, and the duration timer pauses while she is off-field. During the **Enlightened Mind** state, Ye Shunguang's skills are enhanced, all **Physical DMG** dealt by her skills becomes **Honed Edge DMG**.
While **Ether Veil: Verdict** is active, when an enemy enters **Ether Veil: Verdict**, they gain a Veil Vulnerability effect based on their current Stun DMG Multiplier. During this, when Ye Shunguang deals DMG to enemies with her skills, enemy Stun DMG Multiplier is ignored and replaced with the Veil Vulnerability bonus. Veil Vulnerability caps at 110%. The effect is removed when **Ether Veil: Verdict** ends.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Shadowtrace Flight
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Support** or **Defense** character:
When a squadmate activates any **Ether Veil**, gain 3 points of **Qingming Sword Force**. If already in the **Enlightened Mind** state, this is instead converted into 3 stacks of **Bearer**.

entries.name: Dreambound Self
entries.text:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 6 **Qingming Sword Force**. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
The **Unity** effect from **Core Passive: Burning Clarity** increases DMG dealt by an additional 10%, and they ignore 20% of the target's DEF.

entries.name: Light & Shadow
entries.text:
The max stack count of **Bearer** increases to 6, and **Culmination** can stack up to 9 times.
While in the **Enlightened Mind** state, each point of **Qingming Sword Force** consumed grants 1 stack of **Culmination**.
**EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Soaring Light** and **Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens**'s DMG ignore 40% of the target's DEF.

entries.name: Swordswoman
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Together into the Dust
entries.text:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 1,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
The Vulnerability bonus provided by **Ether Veil: Verdict** is increased to a maximum of 200%.

entries.name: Guiding Glimmer
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Lantern Wish
entries.text:
Upon entering the battlefield, gains 2 stacks of **Lantern Wish**.
When entering the **Enlightened Mind** state, gains 1 stack of **Lantern Wish**, stacking up to 4 times.
With 3 stacks of **Lantern Wish**, **EX Special Attack: Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust** is replaced with **Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens**. When this **Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens** is activated, it consumes 3 stacks of **Lantern Wish**.
The last hit of **Enlightened Mind - Return to Dust** and **Ultimate: Cleaving Heavens** deal 1,500% of ATK as additional **Physical DMG**.
